---

# MSBuild Code Review — `StyleIssues.sln`

**Scope:** 2 C# projects (LibA, LibB), 2 F# projects (BrokenOrder, OrderService), root `Directory.Build.props`/`.targets`, F#-subfolder `Directory.Build.props`/`.targets`, solution file.

---

## 🔴 Errors (will cause incorrect builds or failures)

### 1. `Directory.Build.props` — TargetFramework condition is dead code (AP-21)
**File:** `Directory.Build.props:10`
```xml
<PropertyGroup Condition="'$(TargetFramework)' == 'net8.0'">
  <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile>
</PropertyGroup>
```
**Problem:** `$(TargetFramework)` is **empty** during `.props` evaluation for single-targeting projects (like all projects in this solution). The SDK's `TargetFramework` dispatching happens inside the SDK `.targets` import, which runs *after* `.props`. This condition never evaluates to true, so `GenerateDocumentationFile` is never set — documentation XML is silently never generated.

**Fix:** Move this block to `Directory.Build.targets`:
```xml
<!-- In Directory.Build.targets -->
<PropertyGroup Condition="'$(TargetFramework)' == 'net8.0'">
  <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile>
</PropertyGroup>
```

---

### 2. `Directory.Build.targets` — Unconditional property overrides crush project-level settings
**File:** `Directory.Build.targets:7-9`
```xml
<PropertyGroup>
  <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
  <Company>Contoso</Company>
  ...
</PropertyGroup>
```
**Problem:** `.targets` is imported **after** each `.csproj`. Any property set unconditionally here *overrides* the project's own value. LibB explicitly sets `<TreatWarningsAsErrors>false</TreatWarningsAsErrors>` (line 13), but this `.targets` file silently stomps it back to `true`. This is the classic "defaults belong in `.props`, not `.targets`" anti-pattern.

**Fix:** Move these to `Directory.Build.props` with conditional defaults:
```xml
<!-- In Directory.Build.props -->
<PropertyGroup>
  <TreatWarningsAsErrors Condition="'$(TreatWarningsAsErrors)' == ''">true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
  <Company Condition="'$(Company)' == ''">Contoso</Company>
  <Authors Condition="'$(Authors)' == ''">Build Team</Authors>
  <Copyright Condition="'$(Copyright)' == ''">Copyright 2024 Contoso</Copyright>
</PropertyGroup>
```
This lets projects override when needed while still providing repo-wide defaults.

---

### 3. `LibA.csproj` — DefineConstants overwrites instead of appending
**File:** `LibA.csproj:13-14`
```xml
<PropertyGroup Condition="$(Configuration) == Debug">
  <DefineConstants>ENABLE_LOGGING</DefineConstants>
</PropertyGroup>
```
**Two problems here:**

**(a)** This **replaces** the SDK-provided constants (`DEBUG`, `TRACE`) instead of appending. Any `#if DEBUG` or `#if TRACE` checks in code will silently stop working in Debug builds.

**(b)** The condition `$(Configuration) == Debug` is **unquoted**. If `$(Configuration)` is ever empty, this evaluates to `== Debug` which is a malformed expression. Always quote both sides.

**Fix:**
```xml
<PropertyGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug'">
  <DefineConstants>$(DefineConstants);ENABLE_LOGGING</DefineConstants>
</PropertyGroup>
